intro: How neighbours organise a building together: meetings, proposals, agreements and shared rules. With «para que» + subjunctive.
p.la comunidad de vecinos.nota: In Spain, the owners of a block of flats form una comunidad and share costs and decisions.
p.el presidente de la comunidad: the chair of the residents' association
p.el presidente de la comunidad.nota: Feminine: la presidenta. In many buildings the post rotates every year.
p.proponer.nota: Irregular like poner: propongo, propuse, propuesto.
p.ponerse de acuerdo: to agree, to reach an agreement
p.encargarse de: to take charge of, to be in charge of
p.encargarse de.nota: Me encargo de las llaves: I'll take care of the keys.
b1.texto:
Most people in Spanish cities live in **pisos** (flats). The owners form **una comunidad de vecinos**, which pays shared costs with **una cuota** and meets once or twice a year in **una reunión de vecinos**.

At the meeting someone **propone** something, the neighbours discuss it, and if they cannot **ponerse de acuerdo**, they **votan**: **la mayoría** decides. The result is **un acuerdo**, and new **normas** are written down.

Useful ways to make a proposal: **Propongo que** + subjunctive, **¿Y si** + present?, **¿Qué os parece si** + present?

To agree or disagree politely: **Me parece bien**, **Estoy de acuerdo**, **No lo veo claro**, **Yo prefiero otra cosa**.
b2.texto:
**Para** + infinitive expresses purpose when the subject is the same: **Pongo un cartel para avisar** (I put up a sign to let people know).

When the person who does the second action is different, use **para que** + subjunctive: **Pongo un cartel para que todos lo sepan** (I put up a sign so that everyone knows).

More examples: **Dejo las llaves para que el técnico pueda entrar.** **Hacemos turnos para que nadie trabaje más que los demás.**
b3.f0: On Thursday afternoon the residents of number twelve met in the entrance hall.
b3.f1: The chair proposed replacing the lift, because it breaks down almost every month.
b3.f2: Some neighbours agreed, but others preferred to wait until next year.
b3.f3: In the end they voted, and the majority agreed to pay for the work in twelve instalments.
b3.f4: They also shared out the cleaning of the stairs on a rota so that nobody works more than the others.
b3.f5: A volunteer will put up a sign in the entrance hall so that everyone knows the new rules.
b5.pregunta: According to the text, what did the chair propose?
b5.o0.refuerzo: La presidenta propuso cambiar el ascensor.
b5.o1.refuerzo: The meeting took place in the entrance hall, but nobody proposed painting it.
b5.o2.refuerzo: The text says the neighbours will clean the stairs themselves, on a rota.
b6.pregunta: How was the decision finally taken?
b6.o0.refuerzo: Al final votaron, y la mayoría aceptó.
b6.o1.refuerzo: She proposed it, but the neighbours voted.
b6.o2.refuerzo: Some wanted to wait, but the majority accepted.
b7.pregunta: Complete: I'm leaving the keys so that the technician can get in.
b7.o1.refuerzo: After «para que» you need the subjunctive, not the indicative.
b7.o2.refuerzo: The infinitive is used with «para» only when the subject is the same.
b8.pregunta: You want to suggest something at the meeting. Which sentence is correct?
b8.o1.refuerzo: After «propongo que» the verb goes in the subjunctive.
b9.o1: We didn't manage to put on our coats.
b9.o1.explicacion: «Ponerse de acuerdo» means to agree; it has nothing to do with clothes.
b9.o2.explicacion: «Acordarse» is to remember; «ponerse de acuerdo» is to agree.
b10.traduccion: The majority agreed to pay for the work.
b11.texto:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (100–120 words).** Your building needs a new rule (noise, pets, bicycles…). Write a short proposal for the residents' meeting using **propongo que** and **para que**.

**Speak (about 2 minutes).** Explain how people who share a home or a building organise themselves in your country.
b9.o0.explicacion: No conseguimos ponernos de acuerdo means we failed to reach an agreement.
